Each tile has a value (shown as a die). Highest total score wins. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0} Components 21 numbered tiles (each shows 2 charms + 1 value) 1 Lucky Charm Medallion (random) 1 reminder tile (for tiles 1 and 21) Setup Randomly assign tile 1 to one player and tile 21 to another. Each player draws 8 tiles face down. Place 3 remaining tiles face up in the center → Central Line . Players reveal and sort their tiles in ascending order → Luck Line . Player with tile 1: Takes the medallion Starts with the small-icon side facing up Turn Structure 1. Tile Selection Medallion holder chooses a tile from their Luck Line. Other player chooses a tile. 2. Determine Priority Compare tile numbers: Small icon → lower number goes first Big icon → higher number goes first 3. Place Tile Active player places tile at one end of Central Line: If matching a charm on that end: Must connect matching charm If two matches possible, choose If no match: Place tile anyway 4. Resolve Opposite Tile If a match was made: Take the tile at the opposite end Add to collection (score its value) If no match: Remove opposite tile from game (discard) 5. Second Player Other player repeats placement + resolution 6. End of Turn Flip medallion Pass it to the other player End of Game Triggered when all tiles are played. Scoring Group collected tiles by identical charm Order groups: Most tiles first Tiebreaker: highest total value Score each group: (Number of tiles) × (sum of values) Total all group scores Winning Player with the highest total score wins. Variants Guessing Variant Players select tiles simultaneously Priority rule ignored Medallion stays in center (still flipped each turn) Simple Variant Remove medallion Players alternate placing tiles Tile values are ignored Glossary Luck Line – Player’s personal row of tiles Central Line – Shared row of tiles in play Medallion – Determines play order Collection – Tiles scored by player Notes / Ambiguities Tile placement choice when both ends match is player-controlled. Discarded tiles are permanently removed. Game appears designed for 2 players only. [Rating: 5/10] Small 2 player domino style tile laying game. It is surprisingly thinky with what tile to play, and for some reason it's hard for me to figure out how things will shake out. I feel like there's not enough room here for a clever play. It's mainly short term, best play in the moment, strategy.
